changeSet.author: MDonato
changeSet.sql: ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[AssetsByTypeUserCantRead] ( @ResourceID int, @AssetTypeID int ) RETURNS TABLE with Schemabinding AS RETURN ( select A.ID as AssetID from [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelation] RR inner join [dbo].[responsibilitytyperelationrule] R on (RR.ResponsibilityTypeID = R.ResponsibilityTypeID and RR.ObjectType = R.[Object] and RR.ObjectID = R.ObjectID) inner join [dbo].[AssetType] Ast on (Ast.[Object] = R.[Object] and Ast.ObjectID = R.ObjectID) inner join [dbo].[Asset] A on (A.AssetTypeID = Ast.ID) inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultAsset] rasset on (rasset.assettypeid = 0 and rasset.AssetID = A.ID and rasset.ruleid = r.id) where RR.PermissionsBitMask & 1 = 0 and Ast.ID = @AssetTypeID and ( exists( select 1 from [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset] rresource where rresource.RuleID = R.ID and rresource.SecurityAsset = 'R' and rresource.SecurityAssetID = @ResourceID ) or exists( select 1 from [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset] rresource inner join dbo.[Organization] D on rresource.SecurityAsset = 'O' and D.ID = rresource.SecurityAssetID inner join dbo.OrganizationResource RD on RD.OrganizationID = D.ID where rresource.RuleID = R.ID and RD.ResourceID = @ResourceID ) or exists( select 1 from [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset] rresource inner join dbo.[Group] G on G.ID = rresource.SecurityAssetID and rresource.SecurityAsset = 'G' inner join dbo.ResourceGroup RG on RG.GroupID = G.ID where rresource.RuleID = R.ID and RG.ResourceID = @ResourceID ) ) and not exists (select 1 from [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem] oride where oride.AssetID = A.ID and oride.ResponsibilityTypeID = R.ResponsibilityTypeID) union all select oride.AssetID as AssetID from [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem] oride inner join [dbo].asset a on (a.id = oride.assetID) inner join [dbo].assettype att on (att.id = a.assettypeid) inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelation] RR on (att.[object] = RR.[objectType] and att.objectid = RR.[Objectid] and RR.ResponsibilityTypeID = oride.ResponsibilityTypeID) inner join reporting.Global_Resource RES on RES.ResourceID = oride.SecurityAssetID and oride.SecurityAsset = 'R' and RES.State = 1 where RR.PermissionsBitMask & 1 = 0 and Att.ID = @AssetTypeID and oride.SecurityAsset = 'R' and oride.SecurityAssetID = @ResourceID union all select oride.AssetID as AssetID from [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem] oride inner join [dbo].asset a on (a.id = oride.assetID) inner join [dbo].assettype att on (att.id = a.assettypeid) inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelation] RR on (att.[object] = RR.[objectType] and att.objectid = RR.[Objectid] and RR.ResponsibilityTypeID = oride.ResponsibilityTypeID) inner join [dbo].[Group] G on oride.SecurityAsset = 'G' and G.ID = oride.SecurityAssetID inner join [dbo].ResourceGroup RG on RG.GroupID = G.ID where RR.PermissionsBitMask & 1 = 0 and Att.ID = @AssetTypeID and RG.ResourceID = @ResourceID )

exists (select 1 from [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem] oride where oride.AssetID = A.ID and oride.ResponsibilityTypeID = R.ResponsibilityTypeID) union select oride.AssetID as AssetID [dbo].ResponsibilityType RT on RT.ID = oride.ResponsibilityTypeID inner join [dbo].asset a on (a.id = oride.assetID) inner join [dbo].assettype att on (att.id = a.assettypeid) inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelation] RR on (att.[object] = RR.[objectType] and att.objectid = RR.[Objectid] and RR.ResponsibilityTypeID = oride.ResponsibilityTypeID) inner join [dbo].[Group] G on oride.SecurityAsset = 'G' and G.ID = oride.SecurityAssetID inner join [dbo].ResourceGroup RG on RG.GroupID = G.ID where RR.PermissionsBitMask & 1 = 0 and Att.ID = @AssetTypeID and RG.ResourceID = @ResourceID )
